# P0 paths for the deep review (stage 2 of the AI review, .github/workflows/code-review.yml job `deep`), in addition to
# every pattern of .github/sensitive-paths.txt. A pull request that touches one gets an adversarial second review
# (.claude/commands/deep-review.md), and auto-merge (scripts/review-automerge.py) then requires a deep review PASS of
# its head. One shell-style pattern per line (fnmatch: `*` also matches `/`); lines starting with # are comments. Both
# readers take this file from the trusted branch (the BASE commit, or the auto-merge workflow's own checkout).

# Identity: authentication, sessions, tokens, CSRF, sign-in limits (backend and frontend)
src/api/internal/identity/*
src/web/src/features/identity/*
*auth*
*session*
*csrf*

# Rate limits
*ratelimit*
*rate_limit*

# Solve: questions, answers, votes and accepted answers (writes under concurrency)
src/api/internal/solve/*

# Grounded assistant (LLM calls, prompt and data exposure)
*assistant*
src/api/internal/platform/llm/*

# SQL: every query file (invariants, ON CONFLICT, read-then-write)
db/queries/*
